source_text: Tertia species qualitatis est affectio et affectionalis qualitas. Affectio autem in qualitate ob hoc ponitur - ais - quia principium qualitatum est; cui etiam reputantur ad momentum accedentes recedentesque aut animi aut corporis passiones. Affectionalis vero qualitas omnibus quibus evenerit, ex maioribus orta causis ita inhaerescit, ut aut magnis molitionibus, aut nullis omnino separetur scribens differentia qualitatum, inter cetera: "Tertia species qualitatis est affectio et affectionalis qualitas
pass_a_gloss: Tertia species qualitatis is affectio and affectionalis qualitas. Affectio however in qualitate on-account-of this places - ais - because starting-point qualitatum is; to-whom also reputantur to momentum accedentes recedentesque or animi or of-the-body passiones. Affectionalis but qualitas to-all to-whom evenerit, from greater orta causis so inhaerescit, so-that/as or magnis molitionibus, or nullis entirely separetur scribens differentia qualitatum, among the-rest: " Tertia species qualitatis is affectio and affectionalis qualitas.
pass_b_english: The third kind of quality is a passing state and an enduring quality of feeling. A passing state is placed among qualities because it is a starting point of qualities. To it are also assigned the experiences of mind or body that come and go in a moment. An enduring quality of feeling, however, arises from more powerful causes and clings to everyone in whom it occurs so firmly that it can be removed only with great efforts—or cannot be removed at all.

choices.why: Image of God in the soul; keep soul not 'mind' or 'life-force'.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied.
